description.value: Baskin-Robbins is a large international hard-scoop ice cream chain with nearly 8,000 stores across 50 countries, offering an extensive rotating menu of ice cream flavours, cakes, sundaes, and frozen beverages. This Surrey location sits on Fraser Highway and is part of the Canadian franchise network. The brand has introduced dairy-free, plant-based options alongside its classic lineup.
